lines: One herb for the charm. Now walk it home — east, through the door.
dialogue_beat1_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: Mugwort first. The potting shed keeps its jars on the high shelf — higher than any apprentice can jump.
An inch of dust on every jar. Wipe them clean to read the labels.
Need something? Type it (T) — a ladder, perhaps. Mind the ink: three conjurings a trip.
dialogue_level01_intro.speaker: witch

lines: One herb found, eight to go.
The charm is patient. The patient is not — back out there soon.
dialogue_level01_outro.speaker: witch
